title: Cantonese Steamed Sea Bass with Ginger & Scallion
description: Sea bass provides ultra-lean protein (34g) with minimal calories, making it ideal for aggressive fat loss protocols. Ginger and scallions contain gingerols and allicin, compounds shown to enhance peripheral insulin sensitivity and reduce vascular inflammation.
diabeticNotes: Steaming preserves the delicate structure of lean sea bass without high-temperature lipid oxidation. Fresh ginger matchsticks stimulate digestive enzymes and enhance peripheral insulin sensitivity.

ingredients.name: fresh sea bass fillet (or cod / halibut), skin scored
heads baby bok choy, halved lengthwise

steps.title: Prep Steamer & Vegetables
steps.description: Bring water to a boil in a steamer. Arrange halved baby bok choy on a heatproof ceramic plate.

steps.title: Steam Sea Bass
steps.description: Place sea bass fillet over the bok choy. Scatter half the julienned ginger on top and steam for 8 minutes.

steps.title: Add Fresh Aromatics
steps.description: Carefully remove the plate from the steamer. Scatter remaining julienned ginger and shredded scallions over the hot fish.

steps.title: Flash Hot Oil
steps.description: Heat sesame oil and olive oil in a small pan until smoking hot. Pour sizzling oil directly over scallions and ginger.

steps.title: Drizzle Tamari & Serve
steps.description: Drizzle tamari soy sauce around the base of the fish and greens. Serve immediately while aromatic.
